text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of our meeting
with Fuji Kiseki……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mm, ahem...
Sorry, my throat's feeling a bit off...
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Is it a cold?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Actually, I went to karaoke yesterday, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They had quite a few obscure musical songs,
so I just got super excited...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got so into the stage mood,
I ended up singing my heart out... *cough*

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Getting carried away and paying the price
is the same whether it's singing or racing, huh...
